description_en: Retrieves the configuration items for cloud platform configuration checks
description_zh: 获取云平台配置检查配置项
name: GetCheckConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource directory member account belongs.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号 ID。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

items.description_en: The periodic execution time point. The value indicates the day of the week
items.description_zh: 周期执行时间点，取值表示每周周几

DaysOfMonth.description_en: The list of days when the policy cycle is monthly
DaysOfMonth.description_zh: 策略周期为月时，日期列表

items.description_en: The day when the policy cycle is monthly

DaysOfMonth.title_en: 策略周期为月时，日期列表。
DaysOfMonth.title_zh: 策略周期为月时，日期列表。

EnableAddCheck.description_en:
Specifies whether to check new check items by default when new check items are added to the selected regulations. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
EnableAddCheck.description_zh:
当所选条例中有新增检查项时，是否默认检查。可取值：

true： 开启
false： 关闭

EnableAutoCheck.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic periodic checks. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
EnableAutoCheck.description_zh:
是否开启自动周期检测。可取值：

true： 开启
false： 关闭

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the check time period, which indicates the hour of the day. The start time and end time of the query can only be selected from the following time intervals.

0 to 6: When the start time is 0, the end time must be set to 6 on the same day.
6 to 12: When the start time is 6, the end time must be set to 12 on the same day.
12 to 18: When the start time is 12, the end time must be set to 18 on the same day.
18 to 24: When the start time is 18, the end time must be set to 24 on the same day. The unit is hours (h)
EndTime.description_zh:
检查时间段结束时间，表示每天几点。 查询的开始时间和结束只能在以下时间区间中选择。

0~6当开始时间为0时，结束时间需要设置为当日6时。
6~12 当开始时间为6时，结束时间需要设置为当日12时。
12~18 当开始时间为12时，结束时间需要设置为当日18时。
18~24当开始时间为18时，结束时间需要设置为当日24时。数值单位为小时（h）

EndTimeSeconds.description_en: The end time of the check, in seconds from 00:00:00 on the current day. Valid values: 1 to 86400. The value 86400 indicates 00:00:00 on the next day. This value is directly passed through from the database and is the only authoritative source for the exact window. For the system default policy (Frequency=6HOURLY) row, this value is always null (not 0), and callers must perform null checks
EndTimeSeconds.description_zh: 检查结束时间，自当日 00:00:00 起的秒数，取值范围 1-86400（86400 表示次日 00:00:00），为数据库原值直接透传，是精确窗口的唯一权威来源。系统默认策略（Frequency=6HOURLY）行恒为 null（不是 0），调用方必须做 null 判断

Exists.description_en: Indicates whether the requested ConfigId has a corresponding policy. When the value is false, the operation still returns a success response and the remaining configuration fields are empty. Callers should render an empty state based on this value and not rely on error codes
Exists.description_zh: 请求的 ConfigId 是否存在对应策略。false 时接口仍返回成功且其余配置字段为空，调用方应据此渲染空态，不要依赖错误码判断
Exists.title_en: 请求的ConfigId 是否存在对应策略。
Exists.title_zh: 请求的ConfigId 是否存在对应策略。

Frequency.description_en:
The frequency type. Valid values:
DAILY: daily
WEEKLY: weekly
MONTHLY: monthly
6HOURLY: every 6 hours
Frequency.description_zh: 频率类型，取值：DAILY:日,WEEKLY:周,MONTHLY:月,6HOURLY:6小时一次
Frequency.title_en: 频率类型，取值：DAILY:日,WEEKLY:周,MONTHLY:月,6HOURLY:6小时一次
Frequency.title_zh: 频率类型，取值：DAILY:日,WEEKLY:周,MONTHLY:月,6HOURLY:6小时一次

IsDefault.description_en: Indicates whether the policy is the default policy

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SelectedChecks.description_en: The check items selected in the policy

CheckId.description_en: The ID of the check item

SectionId.description_en: The section ID of the check item

Standards.description_en: The list of check item information

Id.description_en: The ID of the check item

ShowName.description_en: The name of the check item

Status.description_en:
The enabling status of the check item. Valid values:

ON: Enabled.
OFF: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
检测项开启状态。可取值：

ON： 开启
OFF： 关闭

Type.description_en:
The type of the check item. Valid values:

RISK: cloud service configuration management
IDENTITY_PERMISSION: identity and permission management
COMPLIANCE: compliance
Type.description_zh:
检测项类型。可取值：

RISK： 云产品配置管理
IDENTITY_PERMISSION：  身份权限管理
COMPLIANCE： 合规

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the check time period, which indicates the hour of the day. The unit is hours (h)
StartTime.description_zh: 检查时间段开始时间，表示每天几点。数值单位为小时（h）

StartTimeSeconds.description_en: The start time of the check, in seconds from 00:00:00 on the current day. Valid values: 0 to 86399. This value is directly passed through from the database and is the only authoritative source for the exact window. For the system default policy (Frequency=6HOURLY) row, this value is always null (not 0), and callers must perform null checks. Do not use the derived StartTime to reverse-engineer this value because the conversion is irreversible
StartTimeSeconds.description_zh: 检查开始时间，自当日 00:00:00 起的秒数，取值范围 0-86399，为数据库原值直接透传，是精确窗口的唯一权威来源。系统默认策略（Frequency=6HOURLY）行恒为 null（不是 0），调用方必须做 null 判断；不得用派生的 StartTime 反推本值，该换算不可逆
